answer: A decaying identity bond blocks fake agents. Each agent posts a 600-credit bond losing 5% per epoch without honest work; each honest epoch adds a plume to its crest, an echo of past deeds. A sybil with 1,000 fakes posts 1,000 x 600 = 600,000 credits, while the pool pays 20,000 per epoch, so it loses 580,000 before earning anything. An honest agent pays once, renews free by working, and after 20 epochs passes the velvet rope into high-value jobs.
